laws.rule: Visitors must follow the law, keep their contract, look after tourism resources, the environment and facilities, respect local customs and religion, follow public order and safety rules and the safety directions of guides and tour leaders (article 56). On a border tour, a visitor must follow the laws of the neighbouring country, respect local customs, and not say or do things that give the neighbouring country a wrong impression (article 65).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
